summary.text: Mary Jane Wallner is a Democratic state representative from Merrimack District 19 who has served since December 7, 2022, and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026, after advancing from the September 8, 2026 primary. She was House Majority Leader in the 2009-2010 session.

paragraphs.text: Wallner's career experience includes working as executive director of the Merrimack Valley Day Care Service, according to Ballotpedia.
She served as president of the New Hampshire Child Care Association, on the New Hampshire Task Force on Child Abuse and Neglect, and on the board of New Hampshire Healthy Kids.
Ballotpedia lists Wallner as chair of the House Finance Committee in the 2013-2014 session and again in 2019-2020, when she was also vice chair of the Rules Committee.
In 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 she was assigned to the House Finance Committee and its Division III.
